dict.string: HereWord Candidate records your voice so it can be transcribed to text. Audio is processed on this computer and is never uploaded or saved.
HereWord Candidate reads selected text, types dictated text, and controls supported music players when you choose to pause or fade their audio.
HereWord Candidate captures the area you select so the text in it can be read aloud. The capture is deleted as soon as the text is extracted.
